name: Twelve Permissions #01 — THE RECOMMENDATION
description: TO TRY SOMETHING I HAD NO BUSINESS TRYING. A guy at work told me about Claude Code. I downloaded it that night. By the time I went to bed there was a hockey trainer running on my own machine, a local file, dots moving in patterns, the thing I had been carrying around in my head for years. I still could not write a line of code. Evidence: The product it eventually became is public at projectintuition.ai.
